evidence: Keep all62 complete lossless Presenter recordings, initial-data assembly manifests, source/protocol hashes, full probe traces, per-case metrics and all four-control comparisons. No outcome-dependent omission.
failure: No strict cancellation or quiet-record witness in the frozen grid is a bounded negative result; an incompatible guide seam, reflected packet, or transient arithmetic C is not success.
continuation: Only independently audited witnesses may enter a building-block claim. A negative grid motivates a separately frozen static converter family or explicit changed candidate, never runtime gating.
